address: Château de Bagnols, Le Bourg, Bagnols, 69620, France
bio: This superb medieval château seems bent on upholding the opulent traditions of banquets of yore… Take a seat by the imposing, delicately carved Gothic fireplace and dig into a feast of infinite refinement. The strawberry-rhubarb dessert is to die for: crunchy strawberry topping, savory-flavoured pannacotta and fresh strawberry purée with a rhubarb sorbet. Wickedly tempting!...
